baseline.description: log2 of the average transcription factor binding signal across randomly scrambled endogenous kmers: a baseline where binding is not expected to occur. Binding is called only for scores above 2 raised to this value. Constant across every variant scored with the same SNP Effect Matrix.

class.description: Evidence tier for the underlying data, taken from the file's fileset metadata: 'observed data' for a direct experimental measurement.

method.description: Model or pipeline that produced this record, taken from the file's fileset metadata.

files_filesets.description: Handle of the files_filesets record for the IGVF file this record was read from.

accessible_via.return: _id, name, tf_name, source, source_url, pwm, length, baseline, class, method, files_filesets
